_comment: S1 SEED — lane-ladder spectrometer campaign (docs/SPEC_lane_spectrometer.md §3.5).
50-station GPS+Galileo, 30 s, COLD start 00:00:00 GPS DOY-129, 3.5 h.
WHY A FRESH RUN AT ALL.  Step 0 of §3.5 says grade a stored lineage if one survives.
Measured on every stored candidate carrying network_dd_fractional.csv for >= 3 h
(t6/t7 12 h arms, t7h 6 h, t4b 305-sta 2 h): the median adjacent-epoch DD step is
1.2-11.6 CYCLES per epoch — 2.4x to 23x the 0.5 cyc window-splitting threshold — so
0.0-0.2 % of arc windows reach the 10-epoch grading minimum and every one of them is
CHURN-GATED (§3.4's last row).  Confirmed not to be a ref_sat-flip artifact: the same
step measured on the re-referenced satellite-PAIR series (reference-independent by
construction) is 1.4-12.5 cyc, and the tail window carries exactly one ref_sat per
(cons,signal).  Those runs also predate the Cards 1d+1e honest instrument.
POSTURE.  Inherits the full standard armed set from the _golden0729 lineage
(raim + attribution + within_epoch + withhold 6.0 + we_code_iono, clock_runaway_check,
sh_health_gate, phase_leveling with a wired MW slip detector, emit_ura,
code_bias_disc_jump_test, cb_excursion_reinit, cold_clock_seed, pcarry ON / preduce OFF,
eq34 + prioritized phase datum, eigen/parallel threads pinned at 8).  mw_wl.enable is
OFF via the wl1off parent so the graded solution carries no WL-1 float layer.
network.sd_ewl stays OFF here: S1 grades the producer AS IT IS, and arming the float
row layer would change the very DDs being graded (measured +0.51 % ev1).
WHAT THIS RUN ADDS over the golden parent, all trace-only and fingerprint-safe:
trace_dd_fractional_max_pairs 2000 + epoch_stride 2 — the cost controls are
LOAD-BEARING (unbounded measured ~45 min/epoch at 305 sta).  At 50 stations the
uncapped pool measures 122-524 DD/epoch, so 2000 never binds and the subsample
(a per-epoch RANDOM reshuffle) never fires — which matters, because if it fired it
would break the arc continuity the ladder needs as p^4 across a 4-row lane join.
trace_phase_anchor — the (cons,signal,sat) -> anchor-station map for the §3.3
anchor partition.  No other artifact carries it.
state_snapshot_* — the S2 virtual-fold input AND crash insurance.
GRADE THE FINAL 60 MIN ONLY:
python scripts/lane_spectrometer.py runs/spectro_3h 3600
3.5 h ends at 03:30 UTC, deliberately short of the 04:00 UTC onset (Card 1e), so the
graded window is 02:30-03:30 and no storm-era epoch enters the verdict.
